summary: @or-sdk/sku-builder preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB blob
details: On `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` script runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a tarball-shipped file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB obfuscated blob using string-array rotation (`WV8StW`), a hex-named constant table (`n7gIxM`), and a runtime string decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — its behavior is not readable from the shipped source. The package advertises itself as a billing SKU builder, a purpose with no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime executing an opaque sibling file at install. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern is used here to run code the package itself never references from `main`, bypassing tooling that inspects only Node-resolved entry points.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
